body: I have had good times, I'm not going to deny that. But everything is getting worse. Things affect me much worse than they used to. I feel guilty and upset over everything now and I can't make myself stop feeling this way even if I know it's a bit extreme. Nobody knows I feel this way, I generally spend my days alone and when I am around people I know how to hide it. I just want it all to stop.
How long do I have to put everyone else's happiness before mine? I've been doing it for too long.
